Strange skies, hidden craft and the stories behind them. Follow the evidence across GTA’s UFO history.
Four documented GTA V craft. San Andreas’ desert lore. Seasonal encounters in GTA Online. Start with the locations and conditions below.
Rockstar describes Cal Hampton monitoring Coast Guard communications and seeing suspicious patterns around him. That establishes a conspiracy-minded character; a connection to aliens is a fan theory.
Our source review found no officially established GTA VI UFO encounter or repeatable sighting route. Earlier games’ 03:00 triggers and completion requirements belong to those games.
A recurring theme. Different kinds of evidence.

UFO stories run through GTA’s history, but a reference is different from an encounter. Night-sky lights in GTA III, Vice City and GTA IV are described by Grand Theft Wiki as distant aircraft effects. San Andreas’ mounted saucer and alien dialogue helped build the myth; GTA V offers craft you can actually find. The evidence does not establish a flying-saucer encounter in every GTA release.

For a new GTA VI sighting, record the unedited footage, game version, map location, in-game time, weather, character and progression. A repeatable result is more useful than an isolated light in a trailer.
